config.label: System-user access token (Business Manager)
config.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

config.label: Primary user access token
config.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

config.label: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured
config.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

config.label: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection
config.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

config.label: Meta app secret
config.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

config.label: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument
config.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

config.label: Graph API version to target
config.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000]
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].

config.label: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64]
config.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].

config.label: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000]
config.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].

config.label: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply
config.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

config.label: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions
config.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument.

config.label: Directory permitted for local media uploads
config.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

config.label: Path to the append-only write journal
config.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.

config.label: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e
config.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.

config.label: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them
config.description: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them. Deny wins over allow.

config.label: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available
config.description: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available.

config.label: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http
config.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.

config.label: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it)
config.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it).

config.label: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http
config.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].

config.label: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package
config.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.

config.label: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e
config.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e.g. cents). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused.

config.label: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error
config.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.
